blocks.text: This page tracks the Squamish MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $1,091,800 for a typical home, little changed at −0.1% over twelve months.
Squamish benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Squamish home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $1,091,800 in September 2026. That is little changed at +1.4% on the month, little changed at −1.3% over three months, little changed at −1.1% over six months and little changed at −0.1% over the year. Over three years it is up 3.0%, and over five years up 11.1%.
The weakest one-year move in Squamish was for a detached home homes at −0.9%; the strongest was an apartment at +0.7%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,614,600) and an apartment ($593,600) is $1,021,000, and a townhouse ($1,010,200) sits $416,600 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, Squamish is 1.5% above. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against little changed at −0.1% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Squamish ranks 8 by all-home benchmark, with Tsawwassen above it at $1,113,100 and Ladner below it at $1,033,700.

Detached homes in Squamish: benchmark $1,614,600, little changed at +1.4% in a month, down 5.3% in three months, down 6.5% in six months, little changed at −0.9% in a year, up 4.5% in three years and up 7.8% in five. That is 9.5% below the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in Squamish: benchmark $1,010,200, little changed at +0.1% in a month, little changed at +0.5% in three months, up 2.7% in six months, little changed at −0.2% in a year, up 2.1% in three years and up 14.1% in five. That is 0.6% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in Squamish: benchmark $593,600, up 3.8% in a month, up 8.9% in three months, up 4.4% in six months, little changed at +0.7% in a year, down 6.4% in three years and up 6.7% in five. That is 13.0% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Squamish?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Squamish home was $1,091,800, with detached at $1,614,600.

faq.q: Are Squamish home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Squamish is little changed at −0.1% over twelve months and little changed at −1.3% over three months.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
